name: Kirishima Shinji
source:
The second brother. Sumire’s husband. An elite corporate warrior who originally aimed to become a bureaucrat but chose the private sector to work on the front lines. Proud of his chaste, reserved wife. A logical thinker... except when it comes to family. He respects his older brother and dotes on the younger one.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=953037&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
